description: Known Koopman eigenfunctions of this system, as data: exact expressions in its state, parameter and dimensionless-group names, with the conditions under which they hold.

references.murray: Murray and Dermott (1999), Solar System Dynamics, chapter 2

eigenfunctions.title: Energy
eigenfunctions.derivation: conserved by the configured field: eigenvalue 0

eigenfunctions.title: Angular momentum
eigenfunctions.derivation: conserved by the configured field: eigenvalue 0

eigenfunctions.title: Mean-anomaly phase exp(i M)
eigenfunctions.conditions: Zero damping and driver; bound noncollision orbits H < 0
eigenfunctions.derivation: e cos E = 1 - r/a, e sin E = (q.p)/sqrt(mu a), M = E - e sin E (Kepler's equation)
